City of Encinitas
Planning Commission
AGENDA
OCTOBER 16, 2025 -
06:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Planning Commission. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. If at least two (2) Planning Commissioners agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
5.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act (open meetings for local bodies, California Government Code Section 54950 et seq.).
6.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the Commission Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Commissioner, or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
6A.
APPROVAL OF MINUTES for the October 2, 2025, Planning Commission meeting.
STAFF CONTACT: Deana Gay, Planning Commission Clerk
Staff recommends approval.
Approval of the October 2, 2025 Minutes
7.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
REGULAR AGENDA - ACTION ITEMS
8A.
PROJECT NAME: Manchester Ave Heritage Tree Nomination; CASE NUMBER: HTREE-008161-2025; FILING DATE: June 18, 2025; APPLICANT: Linda McDonough;
LOCATION: 2279 Manchester Ave (APN 261-072-17); PROJECT DESCRIPTION: A request for a Torrey Pine Tree to be granted with Heritage Tree  Status on private property; ZONING/OVERLAY: The project site is located within the Residential 11 (R-11) Zone, and Coastal Overlay Zone; ENVIRONMENTAL STATUS: The request is exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3) when it can be seen with certainty that there is no possibility that the activity in question may have a significant effect on the environment and the activity is not subject to CEQA. None of the exceptions in Section 15300.2 exists.
STAFF CONTACT: Hoger Saleh, Assistant Planner, 760-633-2714, hsaleh@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends approval.
Manchester Heritage Tree Nomination - Staff report
8B.
PLANNING COMMISSION REPORTING AND WORK PLAN
STAFF CONTACT: Meagan Openshaw, Assistant Director of Development Services: (760) 633-2724 or mopenshaw@encinitasca.gov
Staff recommends: Initiate discussion of the revised Work Plan.
Planning Commission Reporting and Work Plan - Staff report
9.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
10.
PLANNING COMMISSION REPORTS
11.
SECRETARY REPORTS
12.
ADJOURNMENT Adjourn to the Planning Commission meeting of November 6, 2025.
